Order 
This is second application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of bail relating to Crime No. 373 of 2023 registered at Police Station - Chachoda, District Guna (M.P.) for the offence under Sections 376 AB, 506 of IPC and Section 5/6 of POCSO Act 2012.
First application of the applicant was dismissed as withdrawn by this Court vide order dated 12.01.2024 in M.Cr.C.No.58113 of 2023.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant argued that the applicant is innocent a n d h a s been falsely implicated.
After disposal of the first application, statements of prosecutrix and her parents have been recorded, however, they have not supported the case of prosecution.
The prosecutrix has denied the allegation in respect to sexual assault by the applicant/accused.
The case is also not supported by medical evidence as no internal or external injuries on the body of the prosecutrix were found.
F.S.L. is also negative.
The applicant is under custody since 16.08.2023.
His custodial interrogation is not required anymore.

Since the prosecutrix has already been examined, therefore,
question of influencing does not arise.
Further submission is that the applicant/accused is the permanent resident of District Guna (M.P.) and there is no possibility of his absconsion or tampering with the prosecution evidence.
Hence, prayed for grant of bail to the applicant.

O n the other hand, learned Panel Lawyer for respondent No.1/State vehemently opposed the bail application and prayed for rejection of present bail application.
Heard learned counsel for the rival parties and perused the case diary.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, but without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, this application is allowed and it is directed that applicant be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court.
Learned State counsel is directed to send an e-copy of this order to the Station House Officer of the concerned Police Station for information and necessary action.
E- copy of this order be sent to the trial Court concerned for compliance, if possible, by the office of this Court.
